hooks.name: Align AI Character Spec Before Task
hooks.description: Loads the AI virtual character specification and applicable steering before a spec task begins, checking scope and acceptance-criteria traceability.

action.prompt: Before implementing this task, read the active feature's requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md plus the relevant .kiro/steering files. Confirm the task maps to acceptance criteria and follows the approved data, privacy, accessibility, and provider-boundary design. Do not broaden scope. If the task conflicts with the specification or its acceptance criteria, stop implementation and update the appropriate spec artifact before coding.
